article.title: Why Customer Migration Tables Need Both Rows and Columns
article.why: Practical analytical English for customer and model decision making.

paragraphs.en:
A migration table answers different questions depending on its denominator. Row percentages show where customers from an old rank went, while column percentages show where customers in a current rank came from.

If sixty percent of last year's Rank 1 stays in Rank 1, that is a retention statement. If only half of today's Rank 1 was already Rank 1 last year, that is a composition statement. Both can be true.

Counts should accompany percentages because a large rate from a small group may have little business impact. Rank thresholds and spending values should also be shown to explain why movement occurred.

Percentile-based ranks require special care. A customer can spend more and still move down if other customers grow faster, because the rank is relative rather than absolute.

New, inactive, and ineligible customers should have explicit categories instead of being silently mixed with normal transitions. This keeps the migration logic interpretable.

A useful report contains the count matrix, row-normalized matrix, column-normalized matrix, rank cutoffs, and selected value metrics. The business question determines which view should lead the discussion.

Analysts should state the comparison population and time period clearly so that a numerical change is not confused with a change in customer composition.

Business interpretation improves when absolute values, relative rates, and operational constraints are reviewed together rather than as isolated model metrics.

A robust decision rule should remain understandable to the people who operate it, because implementation details can change the value of an otherwise strong analytical result.

paragraphs.zh: Migration table的row percentage回答去年各rank顧客今年去了哪裡，column percentage回答今年各rank顧客從哪裡來。應同時看count、threshold與value metrics，並將new/inactive/ineligible分開。
paragraphs.ja: Migration tableのrow比率は前年rankの行き先、column比率は今年rankの出所を示します。count、threshold、value metricも併記し、new/inactive/ineligibleを分離すると解釈が明確になります。
